# Health-Feature Rollout Strategy for a Global Wearables Portfolio
## "One device, one algorithm, four claim rungs"

---

## 1. Diagnose correctly: classification is an output, not an input

The instinct is to treat regulatory class as a geographic fact you receive and then react to. It isn't. **Regulatory class is downstream of the claim you choose to make.** Hardware, sensor, and algorithm can be identical across all markets; what varies is the *intended-use string*, the *result you show*, and the *action you tell the user to take*. Those are product decisions.

So this is not one problem ("get approved in N countries"). It is four separable dials:

| Dial | What actually varies | Wrong response | Right response |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Claim** (intended use) | Whether the output names a disease, quantifies it, or directs a clinical action | Ship the strongest claim the local regulator tolerates | A **global claim ladder** with fixed rungs; each market is assigned a rung |
| **Evidence** | Reference-standard expectations, local-population data demands, ethnicity/BMI/skin-tone phenotype validity | Run a study per submission | One global pivotal **spine** + thin, cheap population extensions |
| **Clinical pathway** | Whether a flagged user can actually get confirmed and treated | Launch screening and hope | No screening launch without a **downstream referral partner** in-market |
| **Trust currency** | What makes a claim believable: regulator, society, payer, KOL, peer | Same campaign, translated | Different *proof source* per market, same underlying evidence |

**Core insight #1 — build to the ceiling, launch from the floor, and never let the floor contaminate the ceiling.** The evidence bar is set by the hardest market (EU MDR + PMDA). The launch date is set by the easiest (wellness markets, zero clock). Those two facts create an obvious sequencing arbitrage — but only if the wellness launch is *claim-disciplined*, because a screenshot of an over-claiming app in Jakarta becomes an off-label-promotion exhibit in an FDA or Notified Body file, and a complaint from Lagos enters the same global post-market surveillance record that feeds the EU clinical evaluation. **Marketing in unregulated markets is regulated by every other market.**

**Core insight #2 — the strategic asset is not sleep-apnea clearance; it's the regulatory-evidence platform that clears features 2 through 6.** A single CE mark is a cost. A standing ISO 13485 Q
